generation.scope: All integral reduced quintic point graphs with disjoint finite residual in a standard AS window, including all singularities, are the two smooth elliptic quintics. The genus-two Gorenstein cubic separator yields a degree-three pencil and forces a double cover with incompatible fixed lengths. The non-Gorenstein cone vertex gives an Ore mark and a conic lift with pole degree at most two instead of three.

open_mathematics: Treat singular integral degree six and seven, using the genus and pencil constraints without assuming smoothness. Continue with embedded components, positive-dimensional fibers, and the general AS test.
